title: WiseBudget — Your Financial Dashboard for Mac
description: Track expenses and income across multiple currencies, sync transactions from Wise and Monobank, plan monthly budgets per category, and visualize spending with charts and analytics. Your data stays on your device.
name: WiseBudget
intro: Track expenses and income across multiple currencies, sync transactions from Wise and Monobank, plan monthly budgets per category, and visualize spending with charts and analytics — all in one native Mac app.

app_store.aria: Download WiseBudget on the Mac App Store
app_store.alt: Download on the Mac App Store

cta_note: Available now on the Mac App Store

sections.heading: See Your Money, Every Way
sections.lead: Four views into the same data — the month, the trend, and the whole picture.

cards.title: Dashboard
cards.body: Income, expenses, and balance for the month, plus your latest transactions at a glance.

cards.title: Budget Plan
cards.body: Set a per-category budget and watch pacing bars fill up as the month goes on.

cards.title: Cashflow
cards.body: Compare income vs. expenses month by month, with a running balance for each.

cards.title: Lifetime
cards.body: Every year at a glance — income vs. expenses trends and cumulative net since day one.

cards.title: Bank Sync
cards.body: Sync transactions automatically from Wise and Monobank, with duplicates detected and skipped.

cards.title: Budget Planning
cards.body: Set a monthly budget per category and track pacing against it in real time.

cards.title: Multi-Currency
cards.body: Track expenses and income across currencies, converted to your base currency automatically.

cards.title: Cashflow Insights
cards.body: See income vs. expenses month by month, plus lifetime trends since your very first transaction.

cards.title: Spending Calendar
cards.body: Browse a daily calendar view of spending to spot the days that broke your budget.

cards.title: Private by Design
cards.body: No accounts, no servers — your financial data stays on your Mac, always.
